purpose: Configuration and separation policy for the MORNING graded-DCA dry-run analytics stream. The morning stream evaluates morning price weakness vs. yesterday's regular-session close on its own 0x-to-3x ladder, tracks a separate morning budget ledger, and writes its own run-state artifacts. It is dry-run/analytics only: no orders, no Robinhood order review, no broker placement. It is INDEPENDENT of, and never valid evidence for, the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b).

morning_task.name: Morning graded DCA dry-run analytics
morning_task.note: Analytics only. Robinhood account 562057042 remains the sole execution broker for the afternoon live task; Alpaca stays read-only. The morning stream places no trades.

sizing_ladder.name: morning_0x_to_3x
sizing_ladder.tier_boundary_rule: min inclusive, max exclusive; the largest tier threshold <= actual drop wins; drop < 0.1% = 0x (no buy).
sizing_ladder.separation_note: This is the MORNING ladder and is intentionally distinct from the afternoon 0x-to-5x ladder in config/sizing_ladder.json.

budget_ledger.separation_note: The morning ledger is a separate session from the afternoon StrategyState / BUDGET_TIERS ledger. Morning dry-run (or any future morning buys) never consume or validate the afternoon 3:20/3:45 daily/weekly budget.

artifact_paths.separation_note: The morning stream writes ONLY under the morning root. It never writes into /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/**, never updates latest_scheduled_run.json, and never touches afternoon scheduled_runs/ folders.

downstream_separation_rules: Afternoon consumers glob only /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/scheduled_runs/** and therefore never traverse the morning root.

A morning run_state has run_type='morning_dca_dry_run', stream='morning', and valid_afternoon_evidence=false; any consumer must exclude it from afternoon scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, and order-count metrics.
The morning stream never updates latest_scheduled_run.json and never writes into afternoon scheduled/manual folders.
